recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit. If the work group wants reader-facing dragon documentation, tooltip text, or a formal index of dragon warnings, handle that through FHIR-55557 or a new tooling decision rather than through this already-published STU3 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-13367 was a Published FHIR-core STU3 change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked for a dragon-style graphic to highlight implementation challenges, especially safety, security, and privacy notes, with category indexing if practical.
initial_application: Git commit e0fb4dcd4e8de6a68f5c9e68dfd37b64ab9b1007, the git-svn import of SVN revision 14473 cited in Jira, created tools/macros/dragons-start.html and tools/macros/dragons-end.html, wired macro loading into the old PageProcessor, and added a first dragon warning around break-the-glass guidance.
additional_context: The current source still contains the dragon macro and active dragon warning blocks across core pages such as HTTP, security, search, JSON, FHIRPath, versions, Resource notes, ValueSet notes, ImplementationGuide notes, and DeviceAlert. The Clinical Safety page and safety-entries CodeSystem provide the central implementer checklist covering safety, privacy, and security concerns. A later 2026 core issue, FHIR-55557, asks for clearer dragon meaning but remains Submitted, while later Applied issues add or remove individual dragon boxes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reconstructing the original category/index proposal now would be a new tooling and editorial design change, not a necessary correction to the current source, and it would overlap unresolved later work about documenting dragon usage.

related_jiras.note: The original application commit also added break-the-glass warning text around security-label guidance.
Submitted 2026 core issue asks for clearer explanation of the dragon icon; it is not a final source-edit decision.
Applied 2025 core issue added a dragon box to DeviceAlert, confirming the mechanism remains available for current warnings.
Applied 2025 core issue removed a SubstanceDefinition dragon warning, showing resource-specific dragon curation is separate from the generic mechanism.
